title: DNA OS ↔ Railway Provider and Runtime Connection
scope: Existing Railway provider identity, read-only environment-status connector, registered read-only Railway CLI capability records, and documented Railway-hosted DNA OS deployments. No new connector, deployment, domain, or mutation path is introduced by this document.

security.rule: Secret values are never recorded. Only reference names, scopes, and resolution mechanisms are recorded.

references.name: resolver_service=dna-os-railway-dna-os-infrastructure-production
references.resolution: MacOsKeychainProvider; secret value is never returned or logged

boundaries.authority_permission: Registry identity is descriptive; it does not grant mutation authority

overall_gaps: The Railway invoker is registered in control/connector-execution-boundary but no railway capability entry exists in control/command-router/capability-registry.ts; direct invoker verification must not be presented as Owner-command routing verification.
The connection declaration target_resolution is UNRESOLVED and state OBSERVED.
Railway CLI capability records have live evidence in the canonical registry, but their caller implementation is not located in this repository.
Railway Postgres exists and its schema was reported applied/verified, but application wiring is explicitly NOT_WIRED.
No Railway deployment/write/mutation connector is implemented or verified.
next_required_connection: Wire and live-verify an explicit Owner command capability for Railway only if requested; separately verify any CLI callers and Postgres application integration. Do not infer deployment/mutation authority from the read-only connection.
